name: ihistand
description: Claude Code plugins for data engineering, business intelligence, 3D printing and product-requirements workflows

plugins.name: sqlanvil-toolkit
plugins.description: Engineering best practices for sqlanvil data projects on PostgreSQL and Supabase: corrects Dataform/BigQuery priors, plus named connections (cross-warehouse sources) and the introspect workflow. Includes /sqlanvil-compile, -test, -run, -new-table, -introspect commands

plugins.name: stl-generator-toolkit
plugins.description: Generate 3D-printable STL files with build123d: woodworking jigs (circle-cutting trammel, exact angle wedges, spacing blocks, custom designs) and replacement parts from a measured original, such as a threaded light globe. A print-readiness check refuses STLs that would misprint and flags overhangs. Defaults to an Elegoo Neptune 4 Pro bed; --bed for any printer.

plugins.name: prd-toolkit
plugins.description: A living PRD as the single authority agents build, test and deploy from: a PRD folder with contracts and black-box test cases, a 27-rule linter and trace checks, a test agent that cannot read your code, and skills to author, adopt and change it. Includes /prd-new, /prd-adopt, /prd-change and /prd-context.
